messages:
maria: quick sync — planning round for next quarter's hosted-api slices. need to pick a primary focus set we can commit to for the roadmap: embeddings SLA & cache tier, rerank determinism/latency improvements, or streaming/resumable chat. customers are pushing on all three. thoughts?

dan: timeline question — do we expect embeddings SLA to require Dedicated capacity or can we ship a software-first cache+tiering solution in hosted?

maria: prefer software-first if it gets us to SLAs quicker. proposal: 1) embeddings: soft SLA (p95 < 150ms for small vectors) + prefix cache tier, 2) rerank: target p95 < 120ms with a blackbox A/B test for relevance, 3) streaming: add resumable chunking for interrupted clients.

tyler: technically rerank p95 < 120ms is tight if we keep current model variants. two options: quantize/reroute smaller model for rerank baseline OR invest in route-level batching. both have accuracy/cost tradeoffs.

dan: for embeddings cache tier — we can implement a hot-cache (redis/rocks) + a cache-hint header so apps can opt-in. little infra overhead. metrics to watch: cache hit rate, p95 lookup latency, mem cost.

sarah: rollout concerns — we need rollout guards per-route and a simple canary playbook. ops asks: automatic rollback if p95 regresses >10% or error rate >0.5% for 30m.

maria: +1. draft canary config:```\ncanary:\n  pct: 5\n  duration: 48h\n  metrics:\n    - p95_latency\n    - failure_rate\n    - client_qps\n    - embed_similarity_regression\n```\n
tyler: embed_similarity_regression is tricky — we'll need an eval set and a moving baseline. I can wire a small daily eval job that runs on a seeded prompt set and reports delta.

dan: cost note — aggressive caching reduces GPU calls but increases egress/ram. need a cost model per 1M requests. I'll mock numbers this week.

maria: customer asks prioritized: Searchly (sub-100ms lookup for low-dim embed), KBCo (deterministic rerank for experiments), Pagerish (resumable chat for flaky mobile). can we map those to quick wins?

tyler: quick wins: emb cache + hint header addresses Searchly. rerank determinism requires model variant + seeding, medium effort. streaming/resumable is mostly protocol + client changes, low infra.

sarah: launch criteria suggestion (per-slice): embeddings: p95 under X (we'll fill with dan's cost notes), cache hit > 60% on typical customer traffic, regression < 1% vs baseline. rerank: p95 target, deterministic pass rate on benchmark > 98%. streaming: resumability tests + session resume < 2s on reconnect.

maria: okay group decision needed: prioritize embeddings + streaming this quarter, push rerank perf to next quarter with dedicated investment. objections? @dan @tyler

dan: :thumbsup: prefer that — gives us time to prototype rerank routing without blocking shipping SLA for embeds.

tyler: fine with that tradeoff. I'll start on the eval harness for rerank and a prototype for routing.

sarah: i'll draft the canary/runbook and notify ops.

maria: owners: embeddings/caching = dan, streaming/resumable = sarah, rerank evaluation & routing prototype = tyler. I'll include these in the product PRD and the roadmap doc. action: dan to post cost model by Thu, tyler to post eval plan by Fri, sarah to post runbook by end of sprint.

deploy-bot: deploy scheduled: hosted-api-canary-config v0.1 -> staging at 2024-04-03T18:00Z

maria: thanks everyone. i'll update the roadmap board and schedule the stakeholder readout for next Tue.
